test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The East-West Corridor connects Silchar in Assam with ________ in Gujarat.
solution:
The correct answer is** __Porbandar__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **East-West Corridor**

 
 
• The Indian cities of **Silchar and Porbandar** are connected via the **Golden Quadrilateral's East-West corridor**.
 
• **National Highways Authority of India (NHAI)** is in charge of overseeing the project under the** Ministry of Road Transport and Highways**. 
 
• The **length** of the golden quadrilateral's East-West corridor is **3,300 kilometres**.
 
• The** East-West corridor** is associated via **National Highway 27**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The biggest highway project (currently under construction) in India is the North-South-East-West Corridor. 
 
• To connect Indian cities like** Srinagar, Kanyakumari, Kochi, Porbandar, and Silchar**, the project of North-South-East-West Corridor will build 7**300 kilometres of four- and six-lane expressways.**
 
• **North-South Corridor**
 
 
• The **4,000-kilometer-long north-south corridor** of the golden quadrilateral connects** Srinagar to ****Kanyakumari/Kochi**.
 
• It is associated with **National Highway 44**.**​**
